title: test(plugin-pinyin-search): boot-reconcile.integration.test.ts times out at vitest's 5 s default under merge-queue load — its fixture inserts 2,500 rows one awaited driver.create at a time
body:
**Filing gate ①: a defect with a named location, measured red in the merge queue.** Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01JVTd3PprStGa26aez5omLB`. ⛔ Not a claim. Domain and grade are triage's. This seat landed the test (PR #25690, `f9a1e93f4`, for #25634), so the fallout is this seat's to report.

## Measured

- **Red:** merge-group run 40162354141 (the queue build for PR #25705, base `f9a1e93f4`), job `Test Core (3/6)`, step "Run this shard's tests". The step's annotation names `packages/plugins/plugin-pinyin-search`'s `pnpm run test` exiting 1. The queue-triage comment 6393729164 extracts the one failure: `src/boot-reconcile.integration.test.ts` › "a first boot walks every row; an unchanged second boot reads none — and a receipt sits in sys_migration": `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.`
- **Green on the same test:** PR #25690's own queue build, run 40162171623, all six `Test Core` shards success. A timeout that passes on one full-suite run and fails on the next is load-sensitive. It is not a behaviour change, and PR #25705 does not touch the package.
- **Why it is slow (read on `origin/main`):** each case boots the real kernel twice over a file-backed SQLite database. Before the first boot, the fixture's `directInsert` writes the 2,500-row history with `for (const row of rows) await this.driver.create(PROBE, row)`, one awaited statement per row. Several cases in the file do this, under vitest's 5 s default; `vitest.config.ts` sets no `testTimeout`.

## Wanted (a proposal; the implementing seat decides)

- **(a), recommended:** write the history in one call. `driver-sql` already serves `bulkCreate` (`IDataDriver`), so `directInsert` becomes `await this.driver.bulkCreate(PROBE, rows)`. That removes the 2,500 round trips and keeps the 5 s default meaningful. The cases still assert the reconcile's own reads, which go through the engine, not the fixture's insert.
- **(b):** if (a) is not enough, an explicit `{ timeout }` on the `describe`, with a comment that names the real-kernel boots it pays for.
- ⛔ Not a skip, a quarantine or a retry.

**Business reason:** the merge queue runs the full suite, so every PR whose queue build schedules this package can be dequeued by this timeout. PR #25705 was, once. Each dequeue rebuilds every PR queued behind it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` lane (#25634's lane).

**Dedupe:** the titles of every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue updated since 2026-10-20, matched on `pinyin|boot-reconcile|timed out`: 1 hit, #25634 itself (the card the test was written for, closed). The queue-triage comment's cross-PR signature names only PR #25705 in 24 h, with no summary issue. **New.**
